title: CoRouter for Teams
body:
One subscription for your whole team: Invite unlimited teammates for free, with no additional seat fees.
Leading models, shared credits: Share credits across your team to use models like Opus 5.5 in Open Design or through the API.
Clear usage, centralized billing: Track team usage while the workspace owner manages the subscription and top-ups.

zh-CN.title: CoRouter：团队共享额度，支持 API 调用
zh-CN.body:
一份订阅，全队使用：免费邀请同事，不限成员，无需另付席位费
顶尖模型，全队共享：团队成员共享额度，既能在 Open Design 中使用 Opus 5.5 等顶尖模型，也能通过 API 调用
用量清晰，付费统一：查看团队使用明细，由所有者统一管理订阅和充值
